judgment.rationale: The discussion identifies the old three-part-only version parser as the likely failure, and current source after merged PR 49414 supports four-component versions. There is no separate design to produce for an already-fixed parser path.
evidence: The reporter is on PowerToys 0.100.2 from Microsoft Store and says both update check and Store reinstall leave them on 0.100.2.
A commenter pointed to old src/common/version/helper.cpp behavior where parsing failed unless the stream reached EOF after three parts.
Current helper.cpp parses either three or four numeric parts and strips v/V and suffixes.
PR 49414 is merged and includes src/common/version/helper.cpp and UnitTestsVersionHelper.cpp changes.
A later commenter proposed an intermediate repair release, which is a release-management suggestion rather than a different root cause.
judgment.recommended_action: Recommend manual installation of the current release and close/mark as handled by the merged parser fix if maintainers agree.

inferences: Manual installation is required because the affected updater cannot discover its own fix.

actions.label: Post fix and recovery guidance

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and for confirming that a Store reinstall still installs 0.100.2. The update check in that version cannot parse the newer four-component release version; that parser was corrected in PR 49414. Because the affected updater cannot discover the newer release itself, please install the current release manually from the PowerToys releases page, then confirm whether subsequent update checks work. This report can be treated as handled by that parser fix unless the manual update still cannot find later releases.
